tsa-a13-v01.quick_english: Now the glad-hearted should go to the worship-place; for wherever the heart is gladdened, fit for absorption into the Lord, it becomes — that alone, not anything else is the mark: even at the saying, meditated-identity alone is the cause; that too is from being-glad alone — nothing else is the place.

tsa-a13-v02.quick_english: But seat-mountain-top and the rest in scripture is to be understood as aimed at this place-pointing.

tsa-a13-v03.quick_english: In these seats and the rest, by the Lord's ordainment, of powers entered by the Lord taking body — like noble lands for the pious, like barbarian lands for the impious; the mountain-top teaching from solitude, from distraction-avoidance, is one-pointed-state — thus.

tsa-a13-v04.quick_english: There before the worship-house, outside alone, one should do the general placing — first on hands, then on the body.

tsa-a13-v05.quick_english: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ, hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ — thus; by these two, expressing power and power-bearer, the two Mālinī-alphabet mantras; with one alone, first power, then power-bearer — thus; in release from foot-tip to head-ending; in enjoyment all is reversed.

tsa-a13-v06.quick_english: For Mālinī the Goddess is the chief Śākta form, all-wish-milking through seed-womb collision.

tsa-a13-v07.quick_english: And meaningful is this name: garlanded with Rudra-power garlands, flowering in fruits, the winter-dissolving-sound bee, holding attainment-release, endowed with giving-taking power — thus from oneness-remembering of ra and la.

tsa-a13-v08.quick_english: Hence very, for even a broken-rite mantra becomes complete through this placing; even a stained Gāruḍa-Vaiṣṇava and the rest, having reached stainlessness, becomes release-giving.

tsa-a13-v09.quick_english: After body-placing, this same placing is for the vessel.

tsa-a13-v10.quick_english: For here, for firmness of realization of non-difference with the Lord, the worship-act is made example: there, of all factors, thus is the Lord-ness of the Lord; there, from sacrificer-support's place-purity-bringing-doings, from vessel-purity-placing, from sacrificer's body-placing, from worshippable's altar-placing.

tsa-a13-v11.quick_english: Thus, even by rite-order alone, making all factors the Lord's, seeing all rites with just this view, without chief knowledge and yoga — one becomes the Supreme Lord.

tsa-a13-v12.quick_english: Thus having placed on the vessel, having worshipped with flowers, smoke and the rest, one should sprinkle the rite-essence and flowers and the rest with its drops.

tsa-a13-v13.quick_english: Then in the halo-circle, on ground or in sky: oṃ to the outer retinue, hail — thus one should worship.

tsa-a13-v14.quick_english: Then at the door-place: oṃ to the door-deity-wheel, hail — thus one should worship.

tsa-a13-v15.quick_english: But if there is an unguarded outer place, having entered, on the maṇḍala-altar-front alone the outer-retinue-door-deity-wheel worship, the aforesaid placing and the rest one should do — not outside.

tsa-a13-v16.quick_english: Then too: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ — thus, having thrown the weapon-muttered flower, having removed obstacles, having meditated, having entered within, with gaze kindled by the Lord's ray, one should see all around the worship-house.

tsa-a13-v17.quick_english: There the release-seeker should stand facing north, so that by the Lord's Aghora-radiance swiftly indeed, burnt-bonded, he may become.

tsa-a13-v18.quick_english: There the Lord's freedom alone, by form-shining, shines forth the direction-principle.

tsa-a13-v19.quick_english: There awareness-light alone is the middle; thence other-division-arising: to be taken as light is above, what is not thus is below; facing light is east, the other west; from being become-facing-light, the next is that-light-stream-rise-place; south from favour; facing it, but from to-be-shone, north — thus the direction-four.

tsa-a13-v20.quick_english: There in the middle the Lord; above his is the north-eastern face; below the underworld face; in the east-and-rest four directions the one called Tatpuruṣa-Aghora-Sadyas-Vāma; in the four-direction-middle the other four.

tsa-a13-v21.quick_english: Thus indeed awareness-glory alone forms direction-difference as form — thus direction is not another principle.

tsa-a13-v22.quick_english: As, as the shadow is to be overstepped — being, before, before, it becomes — so reaching the Lord's centrality: being all-presiding alone is centrality — thus it is said.

tsa-a13-v23.quick_english: Thus as the Lord is the divider of directions, so the sun — for it indeed is the Lord's knowledge-power — thus said: there, there, there the east is of the manifest from the east; and just where, so there — thus self-ruled even, facing one's own place, is in front.

tsa-a13-v24.quick_english: Thus by self-sun-Lord-triad-unification is direction-discussion — thus Abhinavagupta's gurus.

tsa-a13-v25.quick_english: Thus standing, facing north one should sit, in body-city-eight and the rest by I-feeling abandonment; body-ness one should burn; from nearness too as another's body, from bodilessness — then mounted on the waveless steady abode, from gaze-nature — which indeed is the first throb-digit — that alone is the form; thereupon is the as-taught worshippable-deity-wheel-placing; chiefly too here the powers are to be worshipped.

tsa-a13-v26.quick_english: From being that seat, and of the Lord-nine-self and the rest, of power alone and of worship-worthiness — thus the gurus.

tsa-a13-v27.quick_english: There five states: waking and the rest; and sixth, called unsurpassed, is the nature-state to be contemplated.

tsa-a13-v29.quick_english: There, from the presiding of causes — Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-Īśa-Sadāśiva-power-formed — each, from thirty-six-principle-group's world-transcended, in Bhairavabhaṭṭāraka-non-difference-course, placing, from fullness, is Bhairavī-being; hence this has no opening.

tsa-a13-v30.quick_english: Which, they said: gained in waveless mounting, again what — is category-emission through placing and the rest — thus.

tsa-a13-v31.quick_english: So long indeed that waveless Bhairava-formed which shows in own self emission-dissolution-variety-peak.

tsa-a13-v32.quick_english: Thus the mutually-meeting-yoga-made Lord's own breath-body-mind, having contemplated, outside and within with flowers-smoke-satings and the rest as possible, one should worship.

tsa-a13-v33.quick_english: There in the body, in breath, in mind and accordingly one should do the trident-lotus-placing — as at base-power-root: root, bulb, to root-pith, at the hanging-end, to kalā-principle's end the staff; Māyā-natured knot; fourfold-natured pure-knowledge lotus; right there the Lord Sadāśiva; he alone the great corpse, through excellence, from dissolved-ness, from awakening, chiefly; from knowable-bodied body-decay, from sound-touch-awareness-nature and the rest.

tsa-a13-v34.quick_english: That risen from the navel, come out of the three head-openings at its top, abiding inside sound, power-pervader, equanimity-formed and the rest, the six-end; thereupon is the pure lotus-triad, beyond-mind; on this universe-made division made seat, presiding as pervading-being, the desired become-supported deity having fashioned — which right there, in same-disposition-full self, universe-being-offering: that alone is worship; which alone becoming-that: that is meditation; which inner-deliberation-being-shaking as of such: that is murmur; which by such-deliberation-order-awakened great-splendour, by that force alone, is universe-self-making: that is oblation; that very thing done thus, the retinue, from that alone, from fire-heap like sparks, having meditated, just so one should worship.

tsa-a13-v35.quick_english: Remembering the twelve-end, the foremost, the trident, from the root.

tsa-a13-v36.quick_english: Leaving sequence, going to the goddess-wheel-front attains sky-going-ness.

tsa-a13-v37.quick_english: From the root-support, to the twice-six-end-sky-peak-filling-natured.

tsa-a13-v38.quick_english: Of sky-going-ness, from sky-faring-rest and from sky-nectar-eating.

tsa-a13-v39.quick_english: Thus by inner-rite alone in reality is done-what-was-to-be-done.

tsa-a13-v40.quick_english: Truly for the then-entered, still outer is to be done, the rite, to remove limitation alone — who too thus does not partake immersion: his chief is the outer rite; from its practice, immersion-gain; since of him too, but the beast-veiling inner rite, when mounted on that too, of his thought-force is purity-giving.

tsa-a13-v41.quick_english: Now when one wishes to do initiation: for the sake of that-days preparation, ground-taking, Gaṇeśa-worship, jar-and-vessel worship, altar-worship, oblation one should do.

tsa-a13-v42.quick_english: But in daily-and-occasional, altar-and-rest worship-oblation alone.

tsa-a13-v43.quick_english: There is initiation-preparation, the disciple's refined-fitness-placing, like sharpening as it were of teeth; the God's toward-work-upturned-ness-grasping, the guru's taking of that.

tsa-a13-v44.quick_english: By being inside the worship-house, the implement-things, through the Lord's radiance-swelling, is bestowing of worship-implement-fitness — thus.

tsa-a13-v45.quick_english: There, having arranged the worship-house full of all implements, having remembered the Goddess Mālinī or Mātṛkā, bearing the taken, full of her-letter-radiance-mass, one should cast the flower-handful.

tsa-a13-v46.quick_english: Then having scattered as possible stated weapon-muttered mustard-grain-parched-rice and the rest, radiance-formed, gathering in order in the north-east — thus is ground-taking.

tsa-a13-v47.quick_english: Then having given the seat up to pure-knowledge's end, Gaṇeśa's worship; then having filled the jar, filled with bliss-substance, adorned, one should worship; then the worshippable next, betel, having placed, there the chief mantra, as all-presiding, remembering with rule-precedence, with that 108-times-muttered, that jar one should make.

tsa-a13-v48.quick_english: In the second vessel, weapons for quelling obstacles one should worship.

tsa-a13-v49.quick_english: Then in own directions the world-guardians with weapons one should worship.

tsa-a13-v50.quick_english: Then to the before-initiated disciple's hand one should give the weapon-vessel.

tsa-a13-v51.quick_english: And oneself the guru should take the jar.

tsa-a13-v52.quick_english: Then making the disciple pour the stream around the house for obstacle-quelling, with jar the guru should follow him, reciting this mantra: O, O Indra! by you in your own direction for obstacle-pacifying.

tsa-a13-v53.quick_english: With attentiveness, to be done at rite's end, by Śiva's command.

tsa-a13-v54.quick_english: In the three-syllabled name, O is one alone — thus.

tsa-a13-v55.quick_english: Then in the north-east direction one should place the jar.

tsa-a13-v58.quick_english: Then in the altar-middle is Supreme-worship.

tsa-a13-v59.quick_english: Then having contemplated the fire-pit as Supreme-power-formed, having kindled fire there, having made one with heart-inner-awakening-fire, with mantra-deliberation-accompaniment, contemplating the blazing Śiva-fire, having placed there, having worshipped, one should sate the mantras with ghee and sesame.

tsa-a13-v60.quick_english: And with the vessel, sprinkling alone: of sesame-ghee and the rest, refining.

tsa-a13-v61.quick_english: And of ladle-and-spoon non-difference-view alone indeed is refining.

tsa-a13-v62.quick_english: Then having offered as able, having arranged ladle-and-spoon up-down-facing as power-and-Śiva-formed, mutually facing, having stood with even feet, contemplating the stream of supreme nectar fallen, risen in the sky of the twelve-end, risen full-Śiva-moon, and uttering the mantra ending in vauṣaḍ, until ghee's end one should stand — thus the full oblation, mantra-wheel-sating.

tsa-a13-v63.quick_english: Then having brought the sprinkled caru, on altar-vessel-jar-fires offering share by share, having left one share over, to the disciple one should give a share.

tsa-a13-v65.quick_english: Its falling in fire-Yama-Nirṛti directions and below is not auspicious — thus.

tsa-a13-v66.quick_english: There oblation by weapon-mantra is to be done.

tsa-a13-v67.quick_english: Then for distraction-avoidance, for fitness to see the future mantra, having made the blindfolded disciple enter, having made him kneeling, one should have him cast a flower-handful.

tsa-a13-v68.quick_english: Then suddenly, unfastened-eye-bound, he — through descent-graced instrument-ness, seeing the present mantra in that place face-to-face, becomes made of that; of graced instruments the mantra-nearness is visible, since as it were of trembling beings.

tsa-a13-v69.quick_english: Then having worshipped the deity-wheel with blazing in one's own right hand, placing it — burning the disciple's bonds on head-heart-navel — one should place down.

tsa-a13-v70.quick_english: Then in the left with gentleness, having worshipped, fattening with pure-principle — then one should bow.

tsa-a13-v71.quick_english: Then the being-deity-direction-offering, full of wine-meat-water and the rest, outside one should give; having sipped.

tsa-a13-v72.quick_english: Then having eaten the oblation-meal oneself, with the disciple-self attaining oneness, awakened-natured one should stay.

tsa-a13-v73.quick_english: Dreaming too, at dawn if the disciple tells an inauspicious dream — that to him one should not explain.

tsa-a13-v74.quick_english: For doubt and fear would be his; merely with the weapon one should make its expiation.

tsa-a13-v75.quick_english: Then just so having worshipped the Lord, having entered before him by the disciple's breath-course, touching the six-cause-touching in the heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends, each eight refinements contemplating, some time resting the disciple-breath right there, again one should descend.

tsa-a13-v77.quick_english: Then to him the worshippable mantra with flowers and the rest one should bestow.

tsa-a13-v78.quick_english: Then the rules to him one should lay down.

tsa-a13-v79.quick_english: In the guru with whole self, devotion; so in scripture; in God; aversion toward their opponents; like the guru, of the guru's son and the rest; of the knowledge-tied made, of the before-initiated and the rest, seeing; of the womb-tie, for its honouring, not by oneself — thus to be deemed.

tsa-a13-v80.quick_english: Of women, of the barren the cause of that-loathing one should not do.

tsa-a13-v81.quick_english: Deity-name, guru-name, and mantra, apart from worship-time one should not utter.

tsa-a13-v82.quick_english: What the guru has enjoyed — bed and the rest — one should not enjoy.

tsa-a13-v83.quick_english: What games and the rest are worldly, that in the guru's nearness one should not do.

tsa-a13-v84.quick_english: Apart from that, elsewhere one should not make excellence-thought.

tsa-a13-v85.quick_english: Everywhere, in śrāddha and the rest, the guru alone one should worship.

tsa-a13-v86.quick_english: And in all occasionals, śākinī and the rest, words one should not say.

tsa-a13-v88.quick_english: With those of lower sight, Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, company one should not make.

tsa-a13-v89.quick_english: Abiding in this teaching, one should not see with former-birth thought.

tsa-a13-v90.quick_english: When the guru's circle has come home, as able one should do worship.

tsa-a13-v91.quick_english: A lower-path abider, a Vaiṣṇava and the rest, having even made him guru, from his teaching-clan, one should abandon.

tsa-a13-v92.quick_english: Even then one should not see with excellence-thought.

tsa-a13-v93.quick_english: With mark-bearers no conduct-meeting one should make; them only as able one should worship.

tsa-a13-v95.quick_english: In the wheel, standing, of last-and-first division, birth-made, one should not fancy.

tsa-a13-v96.quick_english: Apart from the body, apart from, no other abode-ford and the rest with high regard one should see.

tsa-a13-v97.quick_english: Constantly one should remember the mantra-heart — thus, so the disciple, having heard, having bowed, having accepted, the guru with wealth-wife-body-up-to gift having pleased, the before-initiated and poor-lordless and the rest sating.

tsa-a13-v98.quick_english: And with the future rule, the image-wheel one should sate.

tsa-a13-v100.quick_english: In mantra-practice, in daily worship, in hearing, in study, entitled; but in the occasional, everywhere the guru alone one should request.
