tsa-a13-v01.speaker: Teacher (place doctrine)
tsa-a13-v01.question: Where is the worship-place?
premises: atha prasannahṛdayo yāgasthānaṃ yāyāt — glad-hearted, go to the worship-place.
tatra yatraiva hṛdayaṃ prasādayuktaṃ parameśvarasamāveśayogyaṃ bhavati — where the heart is gladdened, fit for Lord-immersion.
tad eva na anyat lakṣaṇam — that alone, not anything else, is the mark.
uktāv api dhyeyatādātmyam eva kāraṇam — even when stated, meditated-identity alone is the cause.
tad api bhāvaprasādād eva — that too from being-glad alone.
iti nānyat sthānam — thus no other place.
tsa-a13-v01.inference: Place = wherever the heart is gladdened; meditated-identity the cause.

option_choices.reason: stated-sense fits meditated-identity frame; absolutive needs same subject

tsa-a13-v02.speaker: Teacher (seats)
tsa-a13-v02.question: What of seats and mountains?
premises: pīṭhaparvatāgram ityādis tu śāstre sthānoddeśa etatpara eva boddhavyaḥ — seat-mountain-top and the rest in scripture: to be understood as aimed at this place-pointing.

tsa-a13-v03.speaker: Teacher (why places help)
tsa-a13-v03.question: How do places help?
premises: teṣu teṣu pīṭhādiṣthāneṣu parameśaniyatyā parameśvarāviṣṭānāṃ śaktīnāṃ dehagrahaṇāt — in seats, by Lord's ordainment, entered powers taking body.
āryadeśā iva dhārmikāṇāṃ mlecchadeśā iva adhārmikāṇām — like noble lands for the pious, barbarian lands for the impious.
parvatāgrādeś caikāntatvena vikṣepaparihārāt aikāgryapadatvam — mountain-top teaching: solitude avoids distraction, one-pointed state.
tsa-a13-v03.inference: Entered powers + solitude-concentration explain helpful places.

tsa-a13-v04.speaker: Teacher (general nyāsa)
tsa-a13-v04.question: What first?
premises: tatra yāgagṛhāgre bahir eva sāmānyanyāsaṃ kuryāt — before the worship-house, outside alone, do the general placing.
karayoḥ pūrvaṃ tato dehe — first on hands, then on the body.
tsa-a13-v04.inference: General placing: hands then body, outside.

tsa-a13-v05.speaker: Teacher (mantras)
tsa-a13-v05.question: With what mantras?
premises: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ ity ābhyāṃ śaktiśaktimadvācakābhyāṃ mālinīśabdarāśimantrābhyām — with the two Mālinī-alphabet mantras expressing power and power-bearer.
ekenaiva ādau śaktiḥ tataḥ śaktimān — with each singly: first power, then power-bearer.
muktau pādāgrāc chiro'ntam bhuktau tu sarvo viparyayaḥ — in release foot-to-head; in enjoyment all reversed.
tsa-a13-v05.inference: Two mantras; Śakti first; foot-to-head for release, reversed for enjoyment.

tsa-a13-v06.speaker: Teacher (Mālinī)
tsa-a13-v06.question: What is Mālinī?
premises: mālinī hi bhagavatī mukhyaṃ śāktaṃ rūpam — Mālinī the Goddess is the chief Śākta form.
bījayonisaṃghaṭṭena samastakāmadugham — by seed-womb collision, all-wish-milking.
tsa-a13-v06.inference: Chief Śākta form; seed-womb collision grants all wishes.

tsa-a13-v07.speaker: Teacher (her name)
tsa-a13-v07.question: Why is the name fitting?
premises: anvarthaṃ caitan nāma rudraśaktimālābhir yuktā — fitting is this name: garlanded with Rudra-power garlands.
phaleṣu puṣpitā — flowering in fruits.
saṃsāraśiśirasaṃhāranādabhramarī — the winter-dissolving-sound bee.
siddhimokṣadhāriṇī — holding attainment-release.
dānādānaśaktiyuktā — endowed with giving-taking power.
iti ralayor ekatvasmṛteḥ — since ra and la are held one.
tsa-a13-v07.inference: Seven epithets unfold the name; ra=la identity noted.

tsa-a13-v08.speaker: Teacher (Mālinī's power)
tsa-a13-v08.question: What does her nyāsa do?
premises: ata eva hi bhraṣṭavidhir api mantra etannyāsāt pūrṇo bhavati — hence even a broken-rite mantra becomes complete through this placing.
sāñjano 'pi gāruḍavaiṣṇavādir nirañjanatām etya mokṣaprado bhavati — even stained Gāruḍa-Vaiṣṇava and the rest, stainless, becomes release-giving.
tsa-a13-v08.inference: Broken and stained mantras completed and purified by her nyāsa.

tsa-a13-v09.speaker: Teacher (vessel)
tsa-a13-v09.question: What next?
premises: dehanyāsānantaram arghapātre ayam eva nyāsaḥ — after body-placing, this same placing on the vessel.

tsa-a13-v10.speaker: Teacher (rite as example)
tsa-a13-v10.question: Why is pūjā the example?
premises: iha hi kriyākārakāṇāṃ parameśvarābhedapratipattidārḍhyasiddhaye pūjākriyā udāharaṇīkṛtā — for firmness of Lord-identity realization, the worship-act is made example.
tatra ca sarvakārakāṇām itthaṃ parameśvarībhāvaḥ — there of all factors thus Lord-ness.

tatra yaṣṭrādhārasya sthānaśuddhyāpādānakaraṇayor arghapātraśuddhinyāsābhyām yaṣṭur dehanyāsāt yājyasya sthaṇḍilādinyāsāt — of sacrificer, support, vessel, sacrificer's body, worshippable, altar: each made Lord through its placing.
tsa-a13-v10.inference: Every factor made Lord through its placing; worship the example.

tsa-a13-v11.speaker: Teacher (seeing the Lord)
tsa-a13-v11.question: What follows?
premises: evaṃ kriyākrameṇāpi parameśvarīkṛtasamastakārakaḥ tayaiva dṛśā sarvakriyāḥ paśyan vināpi pramukhajñānayogābhyāṃ parameśvara eva bhavati — thus, all factors Lord-made, seeing all rites with just this view, without chief knowledge and yoga, one becomes the Supreme Lord.
tsa-a13-v11.inference: Seeing all factors as Lord = becoming Lord, no yoga needed.

tsa-a13-v12.speaker: Teacher (sprinkling)
tsa-a13-v12.question: How close?
premises: evam arghapātre nyasya puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tadvipruḍbhir yāgasāraṃ puṣpādi ca prokṣayet — on the vessel placed, worshipped, sprinkle rite-essence and flowers with its drops.

tsa-a13-v13.speaker: Teacher (retinue)
tsa-a13-v13.question: How honor the retinue?
premises: tataḥ prabhāmaṇḍale bhūmau khe vā oṃ bāhyaparivārāya nama iti pūjayet — in halo-circle, on ground or in sky: oṃ to the outer retinue, hail.
tsa-a13-v13.inference: Halo-circle retinue worship, ground or sky.

tsa-a13-v14.speaker: Teacher (door)
tsa-a13-v14.question: How enter?
premises: tato dvārasthāne oṃ dvāradevatācakrāya nama iti pūjayet — at the door-place: oṃ to the door-deity-wheel, hail.

tsa-a13-v15.speaker: Teacher (outer rite)
tsa-a13-v15.question: What if unguarded outside?
premises: agupte tu bahiḥsthāne sati praviśya maṇḍalasthaṇḍilāgra eva bāhyaparivāradevatācakrapūjāṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca nyāsādi kuryāt na bahiḥ — if unguarded outside, having entered: on the maṇḍala-altar-front alone do outer-retinue worship and the aforesaid placing; not outside.

tsa-a13-v16.speaker: Teacher (clearing)
tsa-a13-v16.question: How clear the way?
premises: tato 'pi phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ iti astrajaptapuṣpaṃ prakṣipya vighnān apasāritān dhyātvā antaḥ praviśya — phaṭ thrice; weapon-muttered flower thrown; obstacles removed meditated; within entered.
parameśvarakiraṇeddhayā dṛṣṭyā abhito yāgagṛhaṃ paśyet — with Lord-ray-kindled gaze see all around the worship-house.

tsa-a13-v17.speaker: Teacher (north facing)
tsa-a13-v17.question: How stand?
premises: tatra mumukṣur uttarābhimukhas tiṣṭhet — the release-seeker stands facing north.
yathā bhagavadaghoratejasā jhaṭity eva pruṣṭapāśo bhavet — so by the Lord's Aghora-radiance swiftly burnt-bonded he may become.

tsa-a13-v18.speaker: Teacher (directions)
tsa-a13-v18.question: What are directions?
premises: tatra parameśvarasvātantryam eva mūrtyābhāsanayā diktattvam avabhāsayati — the Lord's freedom alone, by form-shining, shines forth the direction-principle.

tsa-a13-v19.speaker: Teacher (middle)
tsa-a13-v19.question: What is the middle?
premises: tatra citprakāśa eva madhyaṃ — awareness-light alone the middle.
tata itarapravibhāgapravṛtteḥ — thence other-division arising.
prakāśasvīkāryam ūrdhvam — to be taken as light: above.
atathābhūtam adhaḥ — what is not thus: below.
prakāśanasammukhīnaṃ pūrvam — facing light: east.
itarat aparam — the other: west.
saṃmukhībhūtaprakāśatvāt anantaraṃ tatprakāśadhārārohasthānaṃ dakṣiṇam — from become-facing-light, the next light-stream-rise-place: south.
ānukūlyāt tatsammukhaṃ tu avabhāsyatvāt uttaram — from favour, facing it, but from to-be-shone: north.
iti dikcatuṣkam — thus the direction-four.

tsa-a13-v20.speaker: Teacher (Bhairava faces)
tsa-a13-v20.question: Who faces where?
premises: tatra madhye bhagavān — in the middle the Lord.
ūrdhve 'sya aiśānaṃ vaktram — above his north-eastern face.
adhaḥ pātālavaktram — below the underworld face.
pūrvādidikcatuṣke śrītatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmākhyaṃ — east-and-rest four: Tatpuruṣa-Aghora-Sadyas-Vāma.
dikcatuṣkamadhye anyāś catasraḥ — in the four-middle the other four.
tsa-a13-v20.inference: Bhairava faces: center, above, below, four quarters, four between.

tsa-a13-v21.speaker: Teacher (directions truth)
tsa-a13-v21.question: Are directions real?
premises: ity evaṃ saṃvinmahimaiva mūrtikṛtaṃ digbhedaṃ bhāsayati — thus awareness-glory alone, formed, shines forth direction-difference.
iti dik na tattvāntaram — thus direction is no other principle.
tsa-a13-v21.inference: Directions = awareness-glory formed; no separate principle.

tsa-a13-v22.speaker: Teacher (centrality)
tsa-a13-v22.question: How is centrality reached?
premises: yathā yathā svacchāyā laṅghayitum iṣṭā satī puraḥ puro bhavati — as the shadow is to be overstepped, being, before, before it becomes.
tathā parameśvaramadhyatām eti — so the Lord's centrality is reached.
sarvaadhiṣṭhātṛtaiva mādhyasthyam — being all-presiding alone is centrality.
ity uktam — thus said.

tsa-a13-v23.speaker: Teacher (sun)
tsa-a13-v23.question: What of the sun?
premises: evaṃ yathā bhagavān digvibhāgakārī tathā sūryo 'pi — as the Lord divides quarters, so the sun.
sa hi pārameśvary eva jñānaśaktir ity uktaṃ — for it indeed is the Lord's knowledge-power, said.
tatra tatra tatra pūrvaṃ vyakteḥ pūrvā — there, there, there: east of the manifest is east.
yatraiva ca tathā tatraiva — just where, so right there.
evaṃ svātmādhīnāpi svasammukhīnasya deśasya purastāttvāt — self-ruled yet facing-own-place in front.
tsa-a13-v23.inference: Sun = Lord's knowledge-power; east wherever manifest; self-ruled yet facing.

tsa-a13-v24.speaker: Teacher (threefold one)
tsa-a13-v24.question: How are three one?
premises: evaṃ svātmasūryaparameśatritayaikībhāvanayā dikcarcā — by self-sun-Lord-triad-unification: direction-discussion.
iti abhinavaguptaguravaḥ — so Abhinavagupta's gurus.

tsa-a13-v25.speaker: Teacher (throne)
tsa-a13-v25.question: What follows?
premises: evaṃ sthite uttarābhimukham upaviśya dehapuryaṣṭakādau ahambhāvatyāgena dehatāṃ dahet — standing thus, facing north sit; burning body-ness in body-city-eight by I-feeling abandonment.
saṃnidhāv api paradehavat adehatvāt — near yet as another's body, from bodilessness.
tato nistrāṅgadhruvadhāmarūḍhasya dṛṣṭisvābhāvyāt — then from waveless-steady-abode-mounted, by gaze-nature.
yā kila ādyā spandakalā saiva mūrtiḥ — which indeed is the first throb-digit: that alone is form.
tadupari yathopadiṣṭayājyadevatācakranyāsaḥ — thereupon the as-taught worshippable-deity-wheel-placing.
prādhānyena ca iha śaktayo yājyāḥ — chiefly too here the powers are to be worshipped.
tsa-a13-v25.inference: I-feeling burnt; waveless abode; first throb-digit form; wheel-placing with powers chief.

tsa-a13-v26.speaker: Teacher (why powers)
tsa-a13-v26.question: Why powers chief?
premises: tadāsanatvāt bhagavannavātmādīnāṃ śakter eva ca pūjyatvāt — from that-being-seat, of the Lord-nine-self and the rest; of power alone, from worship-worthiness.
iti guravaḥ — so the gurus.
tsa-a13-v26.inference: Seat-ness and power's worthiness: gurus' reason.

tsa-a13-v27.speaker: Teacher (states)
tsa-a13-v27.question: Which states contemplated?
premises: tatra ca pañca avasthā jāgradādyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī ca anuttarā nāma svabhāvadaśā anusaṃdheyā — five states waking and the rest; sixth called unsurpassed, nature-state: to be contemplated.

tsa-a13-v28.speaker: Teacher (sixfold seal)
tsa-a13-v28.question: How many?
premises: iti ṣoḍhā nyāso bhavati — thus sixfold is the placing.

tsa-a13-v29.speaker: Teacher (fullness)
tsa-a13-v29.question: What is fullness?
premises: tatra kāraṇānāṃ brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivaśaktirūpāṇāṃ pratyekam adhiṣṭhānāt — by each cause's presiding, Brahmā-to-power-formed.
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakalāpasya laukikatattvottīrṇasya bhairavabhaṭṭārakābhedavṛtte nyāse pūrṇatvāt — of the 36-principle-group, world-transcended, in Bhairava-non-difference-course placing, from fullness.
bhairavībhāvaḥ — Bhairavī-being.
tena etat anavakāśam — hence this has no opening.
tsa-a13-v29.inference: Presiding causes; transcended group; fullness = Bhairavī-being; no opening.

tsa-a13-v30.speaker: Question (need)
tsa-a13-v30.question: What need of more?
premises: yad āhuḥ ataraṅgarūḍhau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ kiṃ tattvasṛṣṭir nyāsādinā iti — which they say: gained in waveless mounting, again what with principle-emission through placing and the rest?
tsa-a13-v30.inference: Objection: waveless gained — why more emission-placing?

tsa-a13-v31.speaker: Teacher (answer)
tsa-a13-v31.question: What answers?
premises: tāvat hi tad ataraṅgaṃ bhairavavapuḥ — so long indeed that waveless Bhairava-formed.
yat svātmani avabhāsitasṛṣṭisaṃhārāvaicitryakoṭi — which in own self shows emission-dissolution-variety-peak.
tsa-a13-v31.inference: Answer: waveless Bhairava shows variety-peak in self.

tsa-a13-v32.speaker: Teacher (seeing)
tsa-a13-v32.question: How see?
premises: evam anyonyamelakayogena parameśvarībhūtaṃ prāṇadehabuddhyādi bhāvayitvā — thus by mutual-meeting-yoga, Lord-made breath-body-mind contemplated.
bahir antaḥ puṣpadhūpatarpaṇādyair yathāsambhavaṃ pūjayet — outside and within, with flowers-smoke-satings as possible, worship.

tsa-a13-v33.speaker: Teacher (trident-lotus)
tsa-a13-v33.question: How the lotus-seat?
premises: tatra śarīre prāṇe dhiyi ca tadanusāreṇa śūlābjanyāsaṃ kuryāt — in body, breath, mind accordingly do the trident-lotus-placing.
tad yathā ādhāraśaktimūle mūlaṃ kanda āmūlasārakaṃ lambikānte kalātattvāntam daṇḍaḥ — as at base-power-root: root, bulb, to-root-pith, hanging-end, to-kalā-principle-end: the staff.
māyātmako granthiḥ — Māyā-natured knot.
catuṣkikātmā śuddhavidyāpadmaṃ — four-natured pure-knowledge lotus.
tatraiva sadāśivabhaṭṭārakaḥ — right there Lord Sadāśiva.
sa eva mahāpretaḥ — he alone the great corpse.
prakarṣeṇa līnatvāt — through excellence dissolved.
bodhāt — from awakening.
prādhānyena — chiefly.
vedyātmakadehakṣayāt — from knowable-bodied body-decay.
nādāmarśātmakatvāt ca — and from sound-touch-awareness-nature.

tsa-a13-v34.speaker: Teacher (inner worship)
tsa-a13-v34.question: What is inner worship?
premises: tan nābhyutthitaṃ tanmūrdharandhratrayanirgataṃ nādāntarvartiśaktivyāpinīsamanārūpamarātrayaṃ dviṣaṭkāntaṃ — That risen from the navel, come out of the three head-openings at its top, abiding inside sound, power-pervader, equanimity-formed and the rest, the six-end.
tadupari śuddhapadmatrayam aunmanasam — thereupon the pure lotus-triad, beyond-mind.

etasmin viśvamaye bhede āsanīkṛte adhiṣṭhātṛtayā vyāpakabhāvena ādheyabhūtāṃ yathābhimatāṃ devatāṃ kalpayitvā — on this universe-made division made seat, presiding as pervading-being, the desired become-supported deity having fashioned.
yat tatraiva samasvabhāvanirbharātmani viśvabhāvārpaṇaṃ tad eva pūjanaṃ — which right there, in same-disposition-full self, universe-being-offering: that alone is worship.
yad eva tanmayībhavanaṃ tad dhyānaṃ — which alone becoming-that: that is meditation.
yat tathāvidhāntaḥparāmarśasadbhāvanādāndolanaṃ sa japaḥ — which inner-deliberation-being-shaking as of such: that is murmur.

yat tathāvidhaparāmarśakramaprabuddhamahātejasā tathābalād eva viśvātmīkaraṇaṃ sa homaḥ — which by such-deliberation-order-awakened great-splendour, by that force alone, is universe-self-making: that is oblation.
tad evaṃ kṛtvā parivāraṃ tata eva vahnirāśer visphuliṅgavat dhyātvā tathaiva pūjayet — that done, retinue, from that like sparks from a fire-heap, having meditated, just so worship.
tsa-a13-v34.inference: Offering = worship; becoming = meditation; shaking = murmur; universe-self-making = oblation; retinue like sparks.

tsa-a13-v35.speaker: Verse (trident)
tsa-a13-v35.question: What is the trident?
premises: dvādaśāntam idaṃ prāgraṃ viśūlaṃ mūlataḥ smaran — remembering this foremost trident, from the root to the twelve-end.
tsa-a13-v35.inference: Remember the trident root to twelve-end.
uncertainties: prāgraṃ fork adjudicated (foremost). viśūlaṃ fork adjudicated (trident).

option_choices.reason: trident-foremost fits root-to-twelve-end remembering; eastern-front unmotivated
rite remembers the trident (śūla-nyāsa above); privative sense contradicts

tsa-a13-v36.speaker: Verse (going)
tsa-a13-v36.question: How go?
premises: devīcakrāgragaṃ tyaktakramaḥ khecaratāṃ vrajet — leaving sequence, going to goddess-wheel-front attains sky-going-ness.

tsa-a13-v37.speaker: Verse (filling)
tsa-a13-v37.question: What fills?
premises: mūlādhārād dviṣaṭkāntavyomāgrāpūraṇātmikā — from root-support, of twice-six-end-sky-peak-filling nature.

tsa-a13-v38.speaker: Verse (living)
tsa-a13-v38.question: On what live?
premises: khecarīyaṃ khasaṃcāramsthibhyāṃ khāmṛtāśanāt — sky-going-ness, from sky-faring-rest and from sky-nectar-eating.

tsa-a13-v39.speaker: Teacher (conclusion)
tsa-a13-v39.question: What suffices?
premises: evam antaryāgamātrād eva vastutaḥ kṛtakṛtyatā — thus by inner rite alone, in reality, done-what-was-to-be-done.

tsa-a13-v40.speaker: Teacher (outer need)
tsa-a13-v40.question: Why outer too?
premises: satyataḥ tadāviṣṭasya tathāpi bahir api kāryo yāgo 'vacchedahānaya eva — truly for the then-entered, still outer is to be done, to remove limitation alone.
yo 'pi tathā samāveśabhāk na bhavati tasya mukhyo bahiryāgaḥ — who too does not partake immersion: his chief is the outer rite.
tadabhyāsāt samāveśalābho — from its practice, immersion-gain.
yatas tasyāpi tu paśutātirodhānāyāntaryāgaḥ — since for him too, to veil beasthood: inner rite.
tadarūḍhāv api tatsaṃkalpabalasya śuddhipradatvāt — when mounted on that too, his resolve-force is purity-giving.
tsa-a13-v40.inference: Outer removes limitation and wins immersion; inner veils beasthood and purifies resolve.

tsa-a13-v41.speaker: Teacher (preparation)
tsa-a13-v41.question: What now?
premises: atha yadā dīkṣāṃ cikīrṣet tadādhivāsanārthaṃ bhūmiparigrahaṃ gaṇeśārcanaṃ kumbhakalaśayoḥ pūjāṃ sthaṇḍilārcanaṃ havanaṃ ca kuryāt — when one wishes initiation, then for preparation: ground-taking, Gaṇeśa-worship, jar-vessel worship, altar-worship, oblation.
tsa-a13-v41.inference: Preparation list: ground, Gaṇeśa, vessels, altar, fire.

tsa-a13-v42.speaker: Daily rite
tsa-a13-v42.question: What of daily?
premises: nityanaimittikos tu sthaṇḍilādyarcanahavane eva — but in daily-and-occasional: altar-and-rest worship-oblation alone.

tsa-a13-v43.speaker: Teacher (adhivāsa defined)
tsa-a13-v43.question: What is adhivāsa?
premises: tatra adhivāsanaṃ śiṣyasya saṃskṛtayogyatādhānam — preparation: the disciple's refined-fitness-placing.
amblīkaraṇam iva dantānāṃ — like sharpening of teeth.
devasya kartavyonmukhatvagrāhaṇam — the God's taking of toward-work-upturness.
guros tadgrahaṇam — the guru's taking of that.
tsa-a13-v43.inference: Adhivāsa: disciple sharpened, God turned, guru taking up.

tsa-a13-v44.speaker: Teacher (things)
tsa-a13-v44.question: What of things?
premises: upakaraṇadravyāṇāṃ yāgagṛhāntarvartitayā parameśatejobṛṃhaṇena pūjopakaraṇayogyatārpaṇam — of implement-things, being inside the worship-house, through Lord-radiance-swelling: worship-implement-fitness bestowing.

tsa-a13-v45.speaker: Teacher (assembly)
tsa-a13-v45.question: How assemble?
premises: tatra sarvopakaraṇapūrṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vidhāya bhagavatīṃ mālinīṃ mātṛkāṃ vā smṛtvā — having arranged the all-implement worship-house, remembered the Goddess Mālinī or Mātṛkā.
tadvarṇatejaḥpuñjabharitaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhāvayan — bearing the taken, full of her-letter-radiance-mass.
puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet — cast the flower-handful.
tsa-a13-v45.inference: Arranged house; remembered Goddess; radiance-mass borne; handful cast.

tsa-a13-v46.speaker: Teacher (ground-taking)
tsa-a13-v46.question: How take ground?
premises: tata uktāstrajaptāni yathāsambhavaṃ siddhārthadhānyākṣatalājādīni tejorūpāṇi vikīrya — stated weapon-muttered mustard-grain-parched-rice, radiance-formed, scattered as possible.
aiśānyāṃ diśi krameṇa saṃghaṭṭayet — gather in order in the north-east.
iti bhūparigrahaḥ — thus ground-taking.
tsa-a13-v46.inference: Scattered mustard gathered north-east: ground taken.

tsa-a13-v47.speaker: Teacher (jar)
tsa-a13-v47.question: How the jar?
premises: tataḥ śuddhavidyāntam āsanaṃ dattvā gaṇapateḥ pūjā — pure-knowledge-end seat given; Gaṇeśa worshipped.
tataḥ kumbham ānandadravyapūritam alaṃkṛtaṃ pūjayet — jar filled with bliss-substance, adorned, worshipped.
tato yājyam anu pūgaṃ nyasya — then the worshippable next, betel placed.
tatra mukhyaṃ mantraṃ sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtayā vidhipūrvakatvena smaran — there the chief mantra, as all-presiding, remembering with rule-precedence.
aṣṭottaraśatamantritaṃ tena taṃ kumbhaṃ kuryāt — with that 108-muttered, make that jar.
tsa-a13-v47.inference: Seat, Gaṇeśa, bliss-jar, betel, chief mantra remembered; 108-muttered jar made.

option_choices.reason: betel placed as offering fits rite; multitude unmotivated

tsa-a13-v48.speaker: Teacher (second vessel)
tsa-a13-v48.question: What of the second?
premises: dvitīyakalaśe vighnaśamanāya astraṃ yajet — in the second vessel, weapons for obstacle-quelling worship.

tsa-a13-v49.speaker: Teacher (guardians)
tsa-a13-v49.question: Who guards?
premises: tataḥ svasvadikṣu lokapālān sāstrān pūjayet — in own directions worship the weaponed world-guardians.

tsa-a13-v50.speaker: Teacher (handing)
tsa-a13-v50.question: What handed?
premises: tataḥ śiṣyasya prāk dīkṣitasya haste astrakalaśaṃ dadyāt — to the before-initiated disciple's hand give the weapon-vessel.

tsa-a13-v51.speaker: Teacher (guru's jar)
tsa-a13-v51.question: What does the guru take?
premises: svayaṃ ca guruḥ kumbham ādadīta — oneself the guru takes the jar.

tsa-a13-v52.speaker: Teacher (procession)
tsa-a13-v52.question: How process?
premises: tataḥ śiṣyaṃ gṛhaparyanteṣu vighnaśamanāya dhārāṃ pātayantaṃ sakumbho 'nugacchet — making the disciple pour the stream around the house, with jar follow him.
imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhan — reciting this mantra.
bho bhoḥ śakra tvayā svasyāṃ diśi vighnapraśāntaye — O O Indra! by you in your own direction for obstacle-pacifying.
tsa-a13-v52.inference: Disciple pours around; guru follows with Indra verse.

tsa-a13-v53.speaker: Teacher (attentiveness)
tsa-a13-v53.question: How behave?
premises: sāvadhānena karmāntaṃ bhavitavyaṃ śivājñayā — with attentiveness, to be done to rite's end, by Śiva's command.
tsa-a13-v53.inference: Attentive to the end, by Śiva's command.

tsa-a13-v54.speaker: Teacher (name)
tsa-a13-v54.question: What name?
premises: tryakṣare nāmni bho ity ekam eva — in the three-syllabled name, 'bho' is one alone.
tsa-a13-v54.inference: 'Bho' is one in the three-syllabled name.

tsa-a13-v55.speaker: Teacher (placing)
tsa-a13-v55.question: Where place?
premises: tata aiśānyāṃ diśi kumbhaṃ sthāpayet — then in the north-east direction place the jar.

tsa-a13-v56.speaker: Teacher (sprinkling)
tsa-a13-v56.question: What over?
premises: vikiropari astrakalaśam — upon the scattered, the weapon-vessel.

tsa-a13-v57.speaker: Teacher (both)
tsa-a13-v57.question: What both?
premises: tata ubhayapūjanam — then worship of both.

tsa-a13-v58.speaker: Teacher (center)
tsa-a13-v58.question: What at center?
premises: tataḥ sthaṇḍilamadhye parameśapūjanam — then in the altar-middle Supreme-worship.

tsa-a13-v59.speaker: Teacher (fire)
tsa-a13-v59.question: How the fire?
premises: tataḥ agnikuṇḍaṃ parameśvaraśaktirūpatayā bhāvayitvā — fire-pit as Supreme-power-formed contemplated.
tatra agniṃ prajvālya hṛdayāntarbodhāgninā saha ekīkṛtya mantraparāmarśasāhityena — fire kindled there, unified with heart-inner-awakening-fire, with mantra-deliberation.
jvalantaṃ śivāgniṃ bhāvayitvā — blazing Śiva-fire contemplated.
tatra nyasya abhyarcya mantrān tarpayet ājyena tilaiś ca — placed, worshipped there; sate mantras with ghee and sesame.
tsa-a13-v59.inference: Fire-pit as power; heart-fire unified; mantras sated with ghee-sesame.

tsa-a13-v60.speaker: Teacher (refining)
tsa-a13-v60.question: How refine?
premises: arghapātreṇa ca prokṣaṇam eva tilājyādīnāṃ saṃskāraḥ — and with the vessel, sprinkling alone is sesame-ghee refining.

tsa-a13-v61.speaker: Teacher (ladle-spoon)
tsa-a13-v61.question: How refine them?
premises: sruksruvayoś ca parameśābhedadṛṣṭir eva hi saṃskāraḥ — and of ladle-and-spoon, non-difference-view alone indeed is refining.

tsa-a13-v62.speaker: Teacher (full oblation)
tsa-a13-v62.question: How the full oblation?
premises: tato yathāśakti hutvā sruksruvau ūrdhvādhomukhatayā śaktiśivarūpau parasparonmukhau vidhāya — offered as able; ladle-spoon up-down-facing as power-Śiva-formed, mutually facing arranged.

samapādotthito dvādaśāntagaganoditaśivapūrṇacandraniḥsṛtapatatparāmṛtadhārābhāvanāṃ kurvan — standing even-footed, contemplating the stream of supreme nectar fallen, risen in the sky of the twelve-end, risen full-Śiva-moon.
vauṣaḍantaṃ mantram uccārayan ca — and uttering the vauṣaḍ-ending mantra.
ājyakṣayāntaṃ tiṣṭhet — until ghee's end stand.
iti pūrṇāhutiḥ mantracakrasaṃtarpaṇī — full oblation, mantra-wheel-sating.
tsa-a13-v62.inference: Even-footed, nectar-stream contemplated, vauṣaḍ uttered till ghee ends.

tsa-a13-v63.speaker: Teacher (caru)
tsa-a13-v63.question: How share caru?
premises: tataś caruṃ prokṣitam ānīya sthaṇḍilakalaśakumbhavahniṣu bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ nivedya ekabhāgam avaśeṣya śiṣyāya bhāgaṃ dadyāt — sprinkled caru brought; on altar-vessel-jar-fires share by share offered; one share left; to the disciple give a share.
tsa-a13-v63.inference: Shared caru; one share left; disciple's share given.

tsa-a13-v64.speaker: Teacher (tooth-stick)
tsa-a13-v64.question: What next?
premises: tato dantakāṣṭham — then the tooth-stick.

tsa-a13-v65.speaker: Teacher (omen)
tsa-a13-v65.question: What of the throw?
premises: tatpāto 'gniyamanirṛtidikṣu adhaś ca na śubha iti — its falling in fire-Yama-Nirṛti directions and below is not auspicious: thus.

tsa-a13-v66.speaker: Teacher (oblation)
tsa-a13-v66.question: What oblation?
premises: tatra homo 'stramantreṇa kāryaḥ — there oblation by weapon-mantra is to be done.

tsa-a13-v67.speaker: Teacher (blindfold)
tsa-a13-v67.question: How bring in?
premises: tato vikṣepaparihāreṇa bhāvimantradarśanayogyatāyai baddhanetraṃ śiṣyaṃ praveśya — for distraction-avoidance, for fitness to see the future mantra, having brought in the blindfolded disciple.
jānusthitaṃ taṃ kṛtvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣepayet — having made him kneeling, have him cast a flower-handful.

tsa-a13-v68.speaker: Teacher (sight)
tsa-a13-v68.question: What on unveiling?
premises: tataḥ sahasā apāsitanetrabandho 'sau śaktipātānugṛhītakaraṇatvāt — suddenly unfastened-eye-bound, through descent-graced instrument-ness.
saṃnihitamantraṃ tatsthānaṃ sākṣātkāreṇa paśyan tanmayo bhavati — seeing the present mantra in that place face-to-face, becomes made of that.
anugṛhītakaraṇānāṃ mantrasaṃnidhiḥ pratyakṣaḥ — of graced instruments mantra-nearness is visible.
yatas trasyatām iva bhūtānām — since as it were of trembling beings.
tsa-a13-v68.inference: Unveiled seeing makes one of that; mantra-nearness visible to graced.

tsa-a13-v69.speaker: Teacher (bonds)
tsa-a13-v69.question: How burn bonds?
premises: tataḥ svadakṣiṇahaste dīpyatayā devatācakraṃ pūjayitvā — in one's own right hand with blazing, having worshipped the deity-wheel.
taṃ hastaṃ mūrdhahṛnnābhiṣu śiṣyasya pāśān dahantaṃ nikṣipet — placing it burning the disciple's bonds on head-heart-navel.
tsa-a13-v69.inference: Blazing right hand burns head-heart-navel bonds.

tsa-a13-v70.speaker: Teacher (left hand)
tsa-a13-v70.question: What with the left?
premises: tato vāme somyatayā pūjayitvā śuddhatattvāpyāyinaṃ — then in the left with gentleness, having worshipped, fattening with pure principle.
tataḥ praṇāmaṃ kuryāt — then bow.
tsa-a13-v70.inference: Gentle left fattens with pure principle; then bow.

tsa-a13-v71.speaker: Teacher (offering out)
tsa-a13-v71.question: What outside?
premises: tato bhūtadevatādigbaliṃ madyamāṃsajalādipūrṇaṃ bahir dadyāt — being-deity-direction-offering, full of wine-meat-water, outside give.
ācāmeta — having sipped.

tsa-a13-v72.speaker: Teacher (staying)
tsa-a13-v72.question: How stay?
premises: tataḥ svayaṃ carubhojanaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyātmanā saha aikyam āpannaḥ prabuddhavṛttiḥ tiṣṭhet — having eaten the oblation-meal oneself, with disciple-self attaining oneness, awakened-natured stay.
tsa-a13-v72.inference: Meal eaten; oneness with disciple; awakened stay.

tsa-a13-v73.speaker: Teacher (dreams)
tsa-a13-v73.question: What of dreams?
premises: svapan api prabhāte śiṣyaḥ cet aśubhaṃ svapnaṃ vadet — dreaming too, at dawn if the disciple tells an inauspicious dream.
tat asmai na vyākuryāt — that to him one should not explain.

tsa-a13-v74.speaker: Teacher (fear)
tsa-a13-v74.question: What of fear?
premises: śaṅkātaṅkau hi tathāsya syātām — doubt and fear would be his.
kevalam astreṇa tanniṣkṛtiṃ kuryāt — merely with the weapon make its expiation.
tsa-a13-v74.inference: Unexplained dreams breed fear; weapon-expiation only.

tsa-a13-v75.speaker: Teacher (entering)
tsa-a13-v75.question: How enter the disciple?
premises: tatas tathaiva parameśvaraṃ pūjayitvā tadagre śiṣyasya prāṇakrameṇa praviśya — just so worshipped the Lord, entered before him by the disciple's breath-course.
hṛtkaṇṭhatālulalāṭarandhradvādaśānteṣu ṣaṭsu kāraṇaṣaṭkasparśaṃ kurvan — in heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends, six six-cause-touchings doing.
pratyekam aṣṭau saṃskārān cintayan — each eight refinements contemplating.
kaṃcit kālaṃ śiṣyaprāṇaṃ tatraiva viśramayya — some time resting the disciple-breath right there.
punar avarohet — again descend.
tsa-a13-v75.inference: Breath-course entry; six places touched; eight refinements each; rest; descend.

tsa-a13-v76.speaker: Teacher (samayin)
tsa-a13-v76.question: What results?
premises: ity evāpāditāṣṭācatvāriṃśatsaṃskāroparikṛtarudrāṃśāpattiḥ samayībhavati — thus effected-forty-eight-refinements-upon-made-Rudra-part-attainment becomes a samayin.

tsa-a13-v77.speaker: Teacher (mantra gift)
tsa-a13-v77.question: What bestowed?
premises: tataḥ asmai pūjyaṃ mantraṃ puṣpādyaiḥ saha arpayet — then to him the worshippable mantra with flowers and the rest bestow.

tsa-a13-v78.speaker: Teacher (rules)
tsa-a13-v78.question: What next?
premises: tataḥ samayān asmai nirūpayet — then the rules to him lay down.

tsa-a13-v79.speaker: Teacher (samaya code)
tsa-a13-v79.question: What are the rules?
premises: gurau sarvātmanā bhaktiḥ — in the guru with whole self, devotion.
tathā śāstre deve tatpratidvaṃdvini parāṅmukhatā — so in scripture; in God; aversion toward their opponents.
guruvat guruputrādeḥ — like the guru, of the guru's son and the rest.
vidyāsambandhakṛtasya tatpūrvadīkṣitādeḥ saṃdarśanam — of the knowledge-tied made, of the before-initiated and the rest, seeing.
yaunasambandhasya tadārādhanārtham na tu svata — of the womb-tie, for its honouring, not by oneself.
iti mantavyam — thus to be deemed.
tsa-a13-v79.inference: Devotion to guru/scripture/God; aversion to opponents; reverence to kin and fellow-initiates.

tsa-a13-v80.speaker: Teacher (women)
tsa-a13-v80.question: What of women?
premises: striyo vandhyāyās tajjugupsāhetuṃ na kuryāt — of women, of the barren that-loathing-cause one should not do.
uncertainties: tajjugupsāhetuṃ formation obscure; reading follows print.

tsa-a13-v81.speaker: Teacher (names)
tsa-a13-v81.question: What of names?
premises: devatānāma gurunāma tathā mantraṃ pūjākālāt ṛte na uccārayet — deity-name, guru-name, and mantra, apart from worship-time, one should not utter.

tsa-a13-v82.speaker: Teacher (guru's things)
tsa-a13-v82.question: What of the guru's things?
premises: gurūpabhuktaṃ śayyādi na bhuñjīta — what the guru has enjoyed — bed and the rest — one should not enjoy.
tsa-a13-v82.inference: Guru-enjoyed things not to be enjoyed.

tsa-a13-v83.speaker: Teacher (play)
tsa-a13-v83.question: What of play?
premises: yat kiṃcit laukikaṃ krīḍādi tat gurusaṃnidhau na kuryāt — what games and the rest are worldly, that in the guru's nearness one should not do.
tsa-a13-v83.inference: No worldly play near the guru.

tsa-a13-v84.speaker: Teacher (excellence)
tsa-a13-v84.question: What of excellence?
premises: tadvyatirekeṇa na anyatra utkarṣabuddhiṃ kuryāt — apart from that, elsewhere one should not make excellence-thought.

tsa-a13-v85.speaker: Teacher (worship)
tsa-a13-v85.question: Whom worship?
premises: sarvatra śrāddhādau gurum eva pūjayet — everywhere, in śrāddha and the rest, the guru alone worship.

tsa-a13-v86.speaker: Teacher (speech)
tsa-a13-v86.question: What not say?
premises: sarveṣu ca naimittikeṣu śākinītyādiśabdān na vadet — and in all occasionals, śākinī-and-the-rest words one should not say.

tsa-a13-v87.speaker: Teacher (festivals)
tsa-a13-v87.question: What of festivals?
premises: parvadināni pūjayet — festival days worship.

tsa-a13-v88.speaker: Teacher (company)
tsa-a13-v88.question: Whose company?
premises: vaiṣṇavādyair adhodṛṣṭibhiḥ saha saṃgatiṃ na kuryāt — with those of lower sight, Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, company one should not make.

tsa-a13-v89.speaker: Teacher (birth)
tsa-a13-v89.question: What of birth?
premises: etacchāsanasthān pūrvajātibuddhyā na paśyet — abiding in this teaching, one should not see with former-birth thought.
tsa-a13-v89.inference: No former-birth thought in this teaching.

tsa-a13-v90.speaker: Teacher (hospitality)
tsa-a13-v90.question: What hospitality?
premises: guruvarge gṛhāgate yathāśakti yāgaṃ kuryāt — when the guru's circle has come home, as able do worship.
tsa-a13-v90.inference: Worship as able for the guru's circle.

tsa-a13-v91.speaker: Teacher (apostates)
tsa-a13-v91.question: What of apostates?
premises: adhomārgasthitaṃ kaṃcit vaiṣṇavādyaṃ tacchāstrakulāt gurūkṛtyāpi tyajet — a lower-path abider, having even made him guru, from his teaching-clan abandon.
tsa-a13-v91.inference: Abandon even a guru-turned-apostate with his clan.

tsa-a13-v92.speaker: Teacher (seeing)
tsa-a13-v92.question: How see them?
premises: tadāpi na utkarṣabuddhyā paśyet — even then one should not see with excellence-thought.

tsa-a13-v93.speaker: Teacher (sects)
tsa-a13-v93.question: What of sects?
premises: liṅgibhiḥ saha samācāramelanaṃ na kuryāt — with mark-bearers no conduct-meeting make.
tān kevalaṃ yathāśakti pūjayet — them only as able worship.
tsa-a13-v93.inference: No mixing with sects; mere as-able worship.

tsa-a13-v94.speaker: Teacher (doubt)
tsa-a13-v94.question: What of doubt?
premises: śaṅkās tyajet — doubts abandon.

tsa-a13-v95.speaker: Teacher (divisions)
tsa-a13-v95.question: What of divisions?
premises: cakre sthitaś caramāgryādivibhāgaṃ janmakṛtaṃ na saṃkalpayet — in the wheel, standing, of last-and-first division, birth-made, one should not fancy.
tsa-a13-v95.inference: No birth-made last-first fancy in the wheel.

tsa-a13-v96.speaker: Teacher (holy places)
tsa-a13-v96.question: What of holy places?
premises: śarīrāt ṛte na anyat āyatanatīrthādikaṃ bahumānena paśyet — apart from the body, no other abode-ford and the rest with high regard see.
tsa-a13-v96.inference: No abode higher than the body.

tsa-a13-v97.speaker: Teacher (dakṣiṇā)
tsa-a13-v97.question: What giving?
premises: mantrahṛdayam anavarataṃ smaret — constantly remember the mantra-heart.

ity evaṃ śiṣyaḥ śrutvā praṇamya abhyupagamya guruṃ dhanadāraśarīraparyantayā dakṣiṇayā paritoṣya — thus the disciple, having heard, bowed, accepted, the guru with wealth-wife-body-up-to gift pleasing.
pūrvadīkṣitāṃś ca dīnānāthādikān tarpayet — and the before-initiated and poor-lordless sating.
tsa-a13-v97.inference: Constant mantra-heart; wealth-to-body dakṣiṇā; sating of priors and poor.

tsa-a13-v98.speaker: Teacher (image)
tsa-a13-v98.question: What image rite?
premises: bhāvividhinā ca mūrticakraṃ tarpayet — and with the future rule, the image-wheel sate.

tsa-a13-v99.speaker: Teacher (seal)
tsa-a13-v99.question: What is he?
premises: itthaṃ samayībhavati — thus one becomes a samayin.
tsa-a13-v99.inference: Thus samayin: seal of the ahnika.

tsa-a13-v100.speaker: Teacher (entitlement)
tsa-a13-v100.question: What entitlement?
premises: mantrābhyāse nityapūjāyāṃ śravaṇe 'dhyayane adhikārī — in mantra-practice, daily worship, hearing, study: entitled.
naimittike tu sarvatra gurum eva abhyarthayet — but in the occasional, everywhere the guru alone request.
tsa-a13-v100.inference: Entitled to practice/study; occasionals need the guru.

tsa-a13-v101.speaker: Teacher (seal)
tsa-a13-v101.question: What rule?
premises: iti sāmayiko vidhiḥ — thus the samayin rule.

tsa-a13-v01.plain_english: Now the glad-hearted should go to the worship-place; for wherever the heart is gladdened and made fit for absorption into the Lord, there it becomes — that alone is the mark, nothing else; for even in the saying, meditated identity alone is the cause, and that too is from being-glad alone — nothing else is the place.
tsa-a13-v01.sanskrit_cite: atha prasannahṛdayo yāgasthānaṃ yāyāt tac ca yatraiva hṛdayaṃ prasādayuktaṃ parameśvarasamāveśayogyaṃ bhavati tad eva na tu asya anyal lakṣaṇam uktāv api dhyeyatādātmyam eva kāraṇam tad api bhāvaprasādād eva iti nānyat sthānam

tsa-a13-v02.plain_english: But seat, mountain-top and the rest in scripture is to be understood as aimed at pointing out this place.
tsa-a13-v02.sanskrit_cite: pīṭhaparvatāgram ityādis tu śāstre sthānoddeśa etatpara eva boddhavyaḥ

tsa-a13-v03.plain_english: In these seats and the rest, by the Lord's ordainment, powers entered by the Lord take body — like noble lands for the pious, like barbarian lands for the impious; the teaching of the mountain-top, through solitude, from distraction-avoidance, is the state of one-pointedness — thus.
tsa-a13-v03.sanskrit_cite: teṣu teṣu pīṭhādisthāneṣu parameśaniyatyā parameśvarāviṣṭānāṃ śaktīnāṃ dehagrahaṇāt āryadeśā iva dhārmikāṇāṃ mlecchadeśā iva adhārmikāṇām parvatāgrādeś caikāntatvena vikṣepaparihārāt aikāgryapadatvam iti

tsa-a13-v04.plain_english: There, before the worship-house, outside alone, one should do the general placing — first on the hands, then on the body.
tsa-a13-v04.sanskrit_cite: tatra yāgagṛhāgre bahir eva sāmānyanyāsaṃ kuryāt karayoḥ pūrvaṃ tato dehe

tsa-a13-v05.plain_english: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ, hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ — thus; by these two, expressing power and the power-bearer, the two Mālinī-alphabet mantras; with each one singly — first power, then the power-bearer — in release from foot-tip to head-end; in enjoyment everything is reversed.
tsa-a13-v05.sanskrit_cite: hrīṃ na pha hrīṃ hrīṃ ā kṣa hrīṃ ity ābhyāṃ śaktiśaktimadvācakābhyāṃ mālinīśabdarāśimantrābhyām ekenaiva ādau śaktiḥ tataḥ śaktimān iti muktau pādāgrāc chiro'ntam bhuktau tu sarvo viparyayaḥ

tsa-a13-v06.plain_english: For Mālinī the Goddess is the chief Śākta form, milking all wishes through the collision of seed and womb.
tsa-a13-v06.sanskrit_cite: mālinī hi bhagavatī mukhyam śāktaṃ rūpaṃ bījayonisaṃghaṭṭena samastakāmadugham

tsa-a13-v07.plain_english: And meaningful is this name: garlanded with Rudra-power garlands, flowered in fruits, the bee of the sound that dissolves the winter of transmigration, holding attainment and release, endowed with the power to give and to withhold — since ra and la are remembered as one.
tsa-a13-v07.sanskrit_cite: anvarthaṃ caitan nāma rudraśaktimālābhir yuktā phaleṣu puṣpitā saṃsāraśiśirasaṃhāranādabhramarī siddhimokṣadhāriṇī dānādānaśaktiyuktā iti ralayor ekatvasmṛteḥ

tsa-a13-v08.plain_english: Hence very, for even a broken-rite mantra becomes complete through this placing; even a stained one — Gāruḍa, Vaiṣṇava and the rest — having reached stainlessness, becomes release-giving.
tsa-a13-v08.sanskrit_cite: ata eva hi bhraṣṭavidhir api mantra etannyāsāt pūrṇo bhavati sāñjano 'pi gāruḍavaiṣṇavādir nirañjanatām etya mokṣaprado bhavati

tsa-a13-v09.plain_english: After the body-placing, this same placing is to be done on the vessel.

tsa-a13-v10.plain_english: For here, for firmness of realization of non-difference with the Lord, the worship-act is made the example: there, of all factors, thus is Lord-ness — there, from the sacrificer's place-purity-bringing-doings, from vessel-purity, from placing, from the sacrificer's body-placing, from the worshippable's altar-placing.
tsa-a13-v10.sanskrit_cite: iha hi kriyākārakāṇāṃ parameśvarābhedapratipattidārḍhyasiddhaye pūjākriyā udāharaṇīkṛtā tatra ca sarvakārakāṇām itthaṃ parameśvarībhāvaḥ tatra yaṣṭrādhārasya sthānaśuddhyāpādānakaraṇayor arghapātraśuddhinyāsābhyām yaṣṭur dehanyāsāt yājyasya sthaṇḍilādinyāsāt

tsa-a13-v11.plain_english: Thus, even by rite-order alone, making all factors the Lord's, seeing all rites with just this view, without chief knowledge and yoga — one becomes the Supreme Lord.
tsa-a13-v11.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kriyākrameṇāpi parameśvarīkṛtasamastakārakaḥ tayaiva dṛśā sarvakriyāḥ paśyan vināpi pramukhajñānayogābhyāṃ parameśvara eva bhavati

tsa-a13-v12.plain_english: Thus, having placed on the vessel, having worshipped with flowers, smoke and the rest, one should sprinkle the rite-essence and the flowers and the rest with its drops.
tsa-a13-v12.sanskrit_cite: evam arghapātre nyasya puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ pūjayitvā tadvipruḍbhir yāgasāraṃ puṣpādi ca prokṣayet

tsa-a13-v13.plain_english: Then in the halo-circle, on ground or in sky: oṃ to the outer retinue, hail — thus one should worship.
tsa-a13-v13.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ prabhāmaṇḍale bhūmau khe vā oṃ bāhyaparivārāya nama iti pūjayet

tsa-a13-v14.plain_english: Then at the door-place: oṃ to the door-deity-wheel, hail — thus one should worship.
tsa-a13-v14.sanskrit_cite: tato dvārasthāne oṃ dvāradevatācakrāya nama iti pūjayet

tsa-a13-v15.plain_english: But when there is an unguarded outer place, having entered, on the maṇḍala-altar-front alone one should do the outer-retinue-door-deity-wheel worship, the aforesaid placing and the rest — not outside.
tsa-a13-v15.sanskrit_cite: agupte tu bahiḥsthāne sati praviśya maṇḍalasthaṇḍilāgra eva bāhyaparivāradvāradevatācakrapūjāṃ pūrvoktaṃ ca nyāsādi kuryāt na bahiḥ

tsa-a13-v16.plain_english: Then too: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ — thus, having thrown the weapon-muttered flower, having removed the obstacles, having meditated, having entered within, with gaze kindled by the Lord's ray, one should see all around the worship-house.
tsa-a13-v16.sanskrit_cite: tato 'pi phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ iti astrajaptapuṣpaṃ prakṣipya vighnān apasāritān dhyātvā antaḥ praviśya parameśvarakiraṇeddhayā dṛṣṭyā abhito yāgagṛhaṃ paśyet

tsa-a13-v17.plain_english: There the release-seeker should stand facing north, so that by the Lord's Aghora-radiance swiftly indeed, his bonds burnt, he may become.
tsa-a13-v17.sanskrit_cite: tatra mumukṣur uttarābhimukhas tiṣṭhet yathā bhagavadaghoratejasā jhaṭity eva pruṣṭapāśo bhavet

tsa-a13-v18.plain_english: There the Lord's freedom alone, by form-shining, shines forth the direction-principle.
tsa-a13-v18.sanskrit_cite: tatra parameśvarasvātantryam eva mūrtyābhāsanayā diktattvam avabhāsayati

tsa-a13-v19.plain_english: There awareness-light alone is the middle; thence, other-division arising: what is taken as light is above, what is not thus is below; what faces the light is east, the other is west; from having become facing-light, the next is that-light-stream-rise-place; south from favour, facing it, but from to-be-shone, north — thus the direction-four.
tsa-a13-v19.sanskrit_cite: tatra citprakāśa eva madhyaṃ tata itarapravibhāgapravṛtteḥ prakāśasvīkāryam ūrdhvam atathābhūtam adhaḥ prakāśanasammukhīnaṃ pūrvam itarat aparam saṃmukhībhūtaprakāśatvāt anantaraṃ tatprakāśadhārārohasthānaṃ dakṣiṇam ānukūlyāt tatsammukhaṃ tu avabhāsyatvāt uttaram iti dikcatuṣkam

tsa-a13-v20.plain_english: There in the middle the Lord; above, his is the north-eastern face; below, the underworld face; in the east-and-rest four directions, the so-called Tatpuruṣa, Aghora, Sadyas, Vāma; in the four-direction-middle, the other four.
tsa-a13-v20.sanskrit_cite: tatra madhye bhagavān ūrdhve 'sya aiśānaṃ vaktram adhaḥ pātālavaktram pūrvādidikcatuṣke śrītatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmākhyaṃ dikcatuṣkamadhye anyāś catasraḥ

tsa-a13-v21.plain_english: Thus indeed awareness-glory alone, formed, shines forth direction-difference — thus direction is not another principle.
tsa-a13-v21.sanskrit_cite: ity evaṃ saṃvinmahimaiva mūrtikṛtaṃ digbhedaṃ bhāsayati iti dik na tattvāntaram

tsa-a13-v22.plain_english: As, as the shadow is to be overstepped — being, before, before, it becomes — so reaching the Lord's centrality: being all-presiding alone is centrality — thus it is said.
tsa-a13-v22.sanskrit_cite: yathā yathā ca svacchāyā laṅghayitum iṣṭā satī puraḥ puro bhavati tathā parameśvaramadhyatām eti sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtaiva mādhyasthyam ity uktam

tsa-a13-v23.plain_english: Thus as the Lord is the divider of directions, so the sun — for it indeed is the Lord's knowledge-power, thus said: there, there, there the east is of the manifest from the east; and just where, so there — thus self-ruled even, facing one's own place, is in front.
tsa-a13-v23.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yathā bhagavān digvibhāgakārī tathā sūryo 'pi sa hi pārameśvary eva jñānaśaktir ity uktaṃ tatra tatra tatra pūrvaṃ vyakteḥ pūrvā yatraiva ca tathā tatraiva evaṃ svātmādhīnāpi svasammukhīnasya deśasya purastāttvāt

tsa-a13-v24.plain_english: Thus by self-sun-Lord-triad-unification is direction-discussion — thus Abhinavagupta's gurus.

tsa-a13-v25.plain_english: Thus standing, facing north one should sit, burning body-ness in body-city-eight and the rest by I-feeling abandonment; from nearness as another's body, from bodilessness — then mounted on the waveless steady abode, from gaze-nature — which indeed is the first throb-digit — that alone is the form; thereupon is the as-taught worshippable-deity-wheel-placing; chiefly too here the powers are to be worshipped.
tsa-a13-v25.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ sthite uttarābhimukham upaviśya dehapuryaṣṭakādau ahambhāvatyāgena dehatāṃ dahet saṃnidhāv api paradehavat adehatvāt tato nistaraṅgadhruvadhāmarūḍhasya dṛṣṭisvābhāvyāt yā kila ādyā spandakalā saiva mūrtiḥ tadupari yathopadiṣṭayājyadevatācakranyāsaḥ prādhānyena ca iha śaktayo yājyāḥ

tsa-a13-v26.plain_english: From being that seat, of the Lord-nine-self and the rest, of power alone and of worship-worthiness — thus the gurus.
tsa-a13-v26.sanskrit_cite: tadāsanatvāt bhagavannavātmādīnāṃ śakter eva ca pūjyatvāt iti guravaḥ

tsa-a13-v27.plain_english: There five states: waking and the rest; and sixth called unsurpassed, nature-state to be contemplated.
tsa-a13-v27.sanskrit_cite: tatra ca pañca avasthā jāgradādyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī ca anuttarā nāma svabhāvadaśā anusaṃdheyā

tsa-a13-v29.plain_english: There from the presiding of causes, Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-Īśa-Sadāśiva-power-formed, each from thirty-six-principle-group, world-transcended in Bhairava-Lord-non-difference-course placing, from fullness is Bhairavī-being; hence this has no opening.
tsa-a13-v29.sanskrit_cite: tatra kāraṇānāṃ brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivaśaktirūpāṇāṃ pratyekam adhiṣṭhānāt ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakalāpasya laukikatattvottīrṇasya bhairavabhaṭṭārakābhedavṛtte nyāse pūrṇatvāt bhairavībhāvaḥ tena etat anavakāśam

tsa-a13-v30.plain_english: Which, they said: gained in waveless mounting, again what with principle-emission through placing and the rest — thus.
tsa-a13-v30.sanskrit_cite: yad āhuḥ ataraṅgarūḍhau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ kiṃ tattvasṛṣṭir nyāsādinā iti

tsa-a13-v31.plain_english: So long indeed that waveless Bhairava-formed, which in own self shows emission-dissolution-variety-peak.
tsa-a13-v31.sanskrit_cite: tāvat hi tad ataraṅgaṃ bhairavavapuḥ yat svātmani avabhāsitasṛṣṭisaṃhārāvaicitryakoṭi

tsa-a13-v32.plain_english: Thus by mutual-meeting-yoga, Lord-made breath-body-mind contemplated, outside and within with flowers-smoke-satings as possible, one should worship.
tsa-a13-v32.sanskrit_cite: evam anyonyamelakayogena parameśvarībhūtaṃ prāṇadehabuddhyādi bhāvayitvā bahir antaḥ puṣpadhūpatarpaṇādyair yathāsambhavaṃ pūjayet

tsa-a13-v33.plain_english: There in the body, in breath, in mind accordingly one should do the trident-lotus-placing — as at base-power-root: root, bulb, to-root-pith, at the hanging-end, to kalā-principle's end the staff; Māyā-natured knot; four-natured pure-knowledge lotus; right there the Lord Sadāśiva; he alone the great corpse; through excellence dissolved, from awakening, chiefly, from knowable-bodied body-decay, and from sound-touch-awareness-nature.
tsa-a13-v33.sanskrit_cite: tatra śarīre prāṇe dhiyi ca tadanusāreṇa śūlābjanyāsaṃ kuryāt tad yathā ādhāraśaktimūle mūlaṃ kanda āmūlasārakaṃ lambikānte kalātattvānto daṇḍaḥ māyātmako granthiḥ catuṣkikātmā śuddhavidyāpadmaṃ tatraiva sadāśivabhaṭṭārakaḥ sa eva mahāpretaḥ prakarṣeṇa līnatvāt bodhāt prādhānyena vedyātmakadehakṣayāt nādāmarśātmakatvāc ca iti

tsa-a13-v34.plain_english: That risen from the navel, come out of the three head-openings at its top, abiding inside sound, power-pervader, equanimity-formed and the rest, the six-end; thereupon is the pure lotus-triad, beyond-mind; on this universe-made division made seat, presiding as pervading-being, the desired become-supported deity having fashioned — which right there, in same-disposition-full self, universe-being-offering: that alone is worship; which alone becoming-that: that is meditation; which inner-deliberation-being-shaking as of such: that is murmur; which by such-deliberation-order-awakened great-splendour, by that force alone, is universe-self-making: that is oblation; that very thing done thus, the retinue, from that alone, like sparks from a fire-heap, having meditated, just so one should worship.
tsa-a13-v34.sanskrit_cite: tan nābhyutthitaṃ tanmūrdharandhratrayanirgataṃ nādāntarvartiśaktivyāpinīsamanārūpamarātrayaṃ dviṣaṭkāntaṃ tadupari śuddhapadmatrayam aunmanasam etasmin viśvamaye bhede āsanīkṛte adhiṣṭhātṛtayā vyāpakabhāvena ādheyabhūtāṃ yathābhimatāṃ devatāṃ kalpayitvā yat tatraiva samasvabhāvanirbharātmani viśvabhāvārpaṇaṃ tad eva pūjanaṃ yad eva tanmayībhavanaṃ tad dhyānaṃ yat tathāvidhāntaḥparāmarśasadbhāvanādāndolanaṃ sa japaḥ yat tathāvidhaparāmarśakramaprabuddhamahātejasā tathābalād eva viśvātmīkaraṇaṃ sa homaḥ tad evaṃ kṛtvā parivāraṃ tata eva vahnirāśer visphuliṅgavat dhyātvā tathaiva pūjayet

tsa-a13-v35.plain_english: Remembering the twelve-end, this foremost trident, from the root.
tsa-a13-v35.sanskrit_cite: dvādaśāntam idaṃ prāgraṃ viśūlaṃ mūlataḥ smaran

tsa-a13-v36.plain_english: Leaving sequence, going to goddess-wheel-front attains sky-going-ness.

tsa-a13-v38.plain_english: Of sky-going-ness, from sky-faring-rest and from sky-nectar-eating.

tsa-a13-v39.plain_english: Thus by inner rite alone, in reality, done-what-was-to-be-done.

tsa-a13-v40.plain_english: Truly for the then-entered, still outer is to be done, to remove limitation alone — and who too thus does not partake immersion: his chief is the outer rite; from its practice, immersion-gain; since for him too, but the beast-veiling inner rite, when mounted on that too, of his thought-force is purity-giving.
tsa-a13-v40.sanskrit_cite: satyataḥ tadāviṣṭasya tathāpi bahir api kāryo yāgo 'vacchedahānaya eva yo 'pi tathā samāveśabhāk na bhavati tasya mukhyo bahiryāgaḥ tadabhyāsāt samāveśalābho yatas tasyāpi tu paśutātirodhānāyāntaryāgaḥ tadarūḍhāv api tatsaṃkalpabalasya śuddhipradatvāt

tsa-a13-v41.plain_english: Now when one wishes to do initiation, then for preparation: ground-taking, Gaṇeśa-worship, jar-and-vessel worship, altar-worship, oblation — one should do.
tsa-a13-v41.sanskrit_cite: atha yadā dīkṣāṃ cikīrṣet tadādhivāsanārthaṃ bhūmiparigrahaṃ gaṇeśārcanaṃ kumbhakalaśayoḥ pūjāṃ sthaṇḍilārcanaṃ havanaṃ ca kuryāt

tsa-a13-v42.plain_english: But in daily-and-occasional: altar-and-rest worship-oblation alone.

tsa-a13-v43.plain_english: There is initiation-preparation, the disciple's refined-fitness-placing, like sharpening of teeth; the God's toward-work-upturned-ness-grasping, the guru's taking of that.
tsa-a13-v43.sanskrit_cite: tatra adhivāsanaṃ śiṣyasya saṃskṛtayogyatādhānam amblīkaraṇam iva dantānāṃ devasya kartavyonmukhatvagrāhaṇam guros tadgrahaṇam

tsa-a13-v44.plain_english: Of implement-things, by being inside the worship-house, through the Lord's radiance-swelling, is bestowing of worship-implement-fitness — thus.

tsa-a13-v45.plain_english: There, having arranged the worship-house full of all implements, having remembered the Goddess Mālinī or Mātṛkā, bearing the taken, full of her-letter-radiance-mass, one should cast the flower-handful.
tsa-a13-v45.sanskrit_cite: tatra sarvopakaraṇapūrṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vidhāya bhagavatīṃ mālinīṃ mātṛkāṃ vā smṛtvā tadvarṇatejaḥpuñjabharitaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhāvayan puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet

tsa-a13-v46.plain_english: Then the stated weapon-muttered mustard-grain-parched-rice and the rest, radiance-formed, having scattered, in the north-east direction gathering in order — thus is ground-taking.
tsa-a13-v46.sanskrit_cite: tata uktāstrajaptāni yathāsambhavaṃ siddhārthadhānyākṣatalājādīni tejorūpāṇi vikīrya aiśānyāṃ diśi krameṇa saṃghaṭṭayet iti bhūparigrahaḥ

tsa-a13-v47.plain_english: Then having given the seat up to pure-knowledge's end, Gaṇeśa's worship; then having filled the jar, filled with bliss-substance, adorned, one should worship; then the worshippable next, having placed betel, there the chief mantra, as all-presiding, remembering with rule-precedence, with that 108-times-muttered, that jar one should make.
tsa-a13-v47.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ śuddhavidyāntam āsanaṃ dattvā gaṇapateḥ pūjā tataḥ kumbham ānandadravyapūritam alaṃkṛtaṃ pūjayet tato yājyam anu pūgaṃ nyasya tatra mukhyaṃ mantraṃ sarvādhiṣṭhātṛtayā vidhipūrvakatvena smaran aṣṭottaraśatamantritaṃ tena taṃ kumbhaṃ kuryāt

tsa-a13-v48.plain_english: In the second vessel, weapons for obstacle-quelling one should worship.

tsa-a13-v49.plain_english: Then in own directions the world-guardians with weapons one should worship.

tsa-a13-v50.plain_english: Then to the previously-initiated disciple's hand one should give the weapon-vessel.
tsa-a13-v50.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ śiṣyasya prāk dīkṣitasya haste astrakalaśaṃ dadyāt

tsa-a13-v51.plain_english: And oneself the guru should take the jar.

tsa-a13-v52.plain_english: Then making the disciple pour the stream around the house for obstacle-quelling, with jar the guru should follow, reciting this mantra: O O Indra! by you in your own direction for obstacle-pacifying.
tsa-a13-v52.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ śiṣyaṃ gṛhaparyanteṣu vighnaśamanāya dhārāṃ pātayantaṃ sakumbho 'nugacchet imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhan bho bhoḥ śakra tvayā svasyāṃ diśi vighnapraśāntaye

tsa-a13-v53.plain_english: With attentiveness, to be done to rite's end, by Śiva's command.

tsa-a13-v54.plain_english: In the three-syllabled name, 'bho' is one alone — thus.
tsa-a13-v54.sanskrit_cite: tryakṣare nāmni bho ity ekam eva

tsa-a13-v55.plain_english: Then in the north-east direction one should place the jar.

tsa-a13-v59.plain_english: Then the fire-pit as Supreme-power-formed having contemplated, fire having kindled there, with heart-inner-awakening-fire made one, with mantra-deliberation-accompaniment, the blazing Śiva-fire having contemplated, placed there, having worshipped, one should sate the mantras with ghee and sesame.
tsa-a13-v59.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ agnikuṇḍaṃ parameśvaraśaktirūpatayā bhāvayitvā tatra agniṃ prajvālya hṛdayāntarbodhāgninā saha ekīkṛtya mantraparāmarśasāhityena jvalantaṃ śivāgniṃ bhāvayitvā tatra nyasya abhyarcya mantrān tarpayet ājyena tilaiś ca

tsa-a13-v60.plain_english: And with the vessel, sprinkling alone is sesame-ghee and the rest's refining.
tsa-a13-v60.sanskrit_cite: arghapātreṇa ca prokṣaṇam eva tilājyādīnāṃ saṃskāraḥ

tsa-a13-v61.plain_english: And of ladle-and-spoon, non-difference-view alone indeed is refining.
tsa-a13-v61.sanskrit_cite: sruksruvayoś ca parameśābhedadṛṣṭir eva hi saṃskāraḥ

tsa-a13-v62.plain_english: Then having offered as able, having arranged ladle-spoon up-down-facing as power-Śiva-formed, mutually facing, having stood even-footed, contemplating the stream of supreme nectar fallen, risen in the sky of the twelve-end, risen full-Śiva-moon, and uttering the vauṣaḍ-ending mantra, until ghee's end one should stand — thus is full oblation, mantra-wheel-sating.
tsa-a13-v62.sanskrit_cite: tato yathāśakti hutvā sruksruvau ūrdhvādhomukhatayā śaktiśivarūpau parasparonmukhau vidhāya samapādotthito dvādaśāntagaganoditaśivapūrṇacandraniḥsṛtapatatparāmṛtadhārābhāvanāṃ kurvan vauṣaḍantaṃ mantram uccārayan ca ājyakṣayāntaṃ tiṣṭhet iti pūrṇāhutiḥ mantracakrasaṃtarpaṇī

tsa-a13-v63.plain_english: Then the sprinkled caru having brought, on altar-vessel-jar-fires share by share having offered, one share having left over, to the disciple one should give a share.
tsa-a13-v63.sanskrit_cite: tataś caruṃ prokṣitam ānīya sthaṇḍilakalaśakumbhavahniṣu bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ nivedya ekabhāgam avaśeṣya śiṣyāya bhāgaṃ dadyāt

tsa-a13-v65.plain_english: Its falling in fire-Yama-Nirṛti directions and below is not auspicious — thus.
tsa-a13-v65.sanskrit_cite: tatpāto 'gniyamanirṛtidikṣu adhaś ca na śubha iti

tsa-a13-v66.plain_english: There oblation by weapon-mantra is to be done.

tsa-a13-v67.plain_english: Then for distraction-avoidance, for fitness to see the future mantra, having brought in the blindfolded disciple, having made him kneeling, one should have him cast a flower-handful.
tsa-a13-v67.sanskrit_cite: tato vikṣepaparihāreṇa bhāvimantradarśanayogyatāyai baddhanetraṃ śiṣyaṃ praveśya jānusthitaṃ taṃ kṛtvā puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣepayet

tsa-a13-v68.plain_english: Then suddenly, unfastened-eye-bound, through descent-graced instrument-ness, seeing the present mantra in that place face-to-face, he becomes made of that; of graced instruments mantra-nearness is visible, since as it were of trembling beings.
tsa-a13-v68.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sahasā apāsitanetrabandho 'sau śaktipātānugṛhītakaraṇatvāt saṃnihitamantraṃ tatsthānaṃ sākṣātkāreṇa paśyan tanmayo bhavati anugṛhītakaraṇānāṃ mantrasaṃnidhiḥ pratyakṣaḥ yatas trasyatām iva bhūtānām

tsa-a13-v69.plain_english: Then in one's own right hand with blazing, having worshipped the deity-wheel, placing it burning the disciple's bonds on head-heart-navel.
tsa-a13-v69.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ svadakṣiṇahaste dīpyatayā devatācakraṃ pūjayitvā taṃ hastaṃ mūrdhahṛnnābhiṣu śiṣyasya pāśān dahantaṃ nikṣipet

tsa-a13-v70.plain_english: Then in the left with gentleness, having worshipped, fattening with pure principle — then one should bow.
tsa-a13-v70.sanskrit_cite: tato vāme somyatayā pūjayitvā śuddhatattvāpyāyinaṃ tataḥ praṇāmaṃ kuryāt

tsa-a13-v71.plain_english: Then the being-deity-direction-offering, full of wine-meat-water and the rest, outside one should give, having sipped.
tsa-a13-v71.sanskrit_cite: tato bhūtadevatādigbaliṃ madyamāṃsajalādipūrṇaṃ bahir dadyāt ācāmeta

tsa-a13-v72.plain_english: Then oneself having eaten the oblation-meal, with disciple-self attaining oneness, awakened-natured one should stay.
tsa-a13-v72.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ svayaṃ carubhojanaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyātmanā saha aikyam āpannaḥ prabuddhavṛttiḥ tiṣṭhet

tsa-a13-v73.plain_english: Dreaming too, at dawn if the disciple tells an inauspicious dream — that to him one should not explain.
tsa-a13-v73.sanskrit_cite: svapan api prabhāte śiṣyaḥ cet aśubhaṃ svapnaṃ vadet tat asmai na vyākuryāt

tsa-a13-v74.plain_english: For doubt and fear would be his; merely with the weapon one should make its expiation.
tsa-a13-v74.sanskrit_cite: śaṅkātaṅkau hi tathāsya syātām kevalam astreṇa tanniṣkṛtiṃ kuryāt

tsa-a13-v75.plain_english: Then just so having worshipped the Lord, entered before him by the disciple's breath-course, touching the six-cause-touching in heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends, each eight refinements contemplating, some time resting the disciple-breath right there, again one should descend.
tsa-a13-v75.sanskrit_cite: tatas tathaiva parameśvaraṃ pūjayitvā tadagre śiṣyasya prāṇakrameṇa praviśya hṛtkaṇṭhatālulalāṭarandhradvādaśānteṣu ṣaṭsu kāraṇaṣaṭkasparśaṃ kurvan pratyekam aṣṭau saṃskārān cintayan kaṃcit kālaṃ śiṣyaprāṇaṃ tatraiva viśramayya punar avarohet

tsa-a13-v77.plain_english: Then to him the worshippable mantra with flowers and the rest one should bestow.
tsa-a13-v77.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ asmai pūjyaṃ mantraṃ puṣpādyaiḥ saha arpayet

tsa-a13-v78.plain_english: Then the rules to him one should lay down.

tsa-a13-v79.plain_english: In the guru with whole self, devotion; so in scripture; in God; aversion toward their opponents; like the guru, of the guru's son and the rest; of the knowledge-tied made, of the before-initiated and the rest, seeing; of the womb-tie, for its honouring, not by oneself — thus to be deemed.
tsa-a13-v79.sanskrit_cite: gurau sarvātmanā bhaktiḥ tathā śāstre deve tatpratidvaṃdvini parāṅmukhatā guruvat guruputrādeḥ vidyāsambandhakṛtasya tatpūrvadīkṣitādeḥ saṃdarśanam yaunasambandhasya tadārādhanārtham na tu svata iti mantavyam

tsa-a13-v80.plain_english: Of women, of the barren that-loathing-cause one should not do.

tsa-a13-v81.plain_english: Deity-name, guru-name, and mantra, apart from worship-time one should not utter.
tsa-a13-v81.sanskrit_cite: devatānāma gurunāma tathā mantraṃ pūjākālāt ṛte na uccārayet

tsa-a13-v82.plain_english: What the guru has enjoyed — bed and the rest — one should not enjoy.

tsa-a13-v83.plain_english: What games and the rest are worldly, that in the guru's nearness one should not do.
tsa-a13-v83.sanskrit_cite: yat kiṃcit laukikaṃ krīḍādi tat gurusaṃnidhau na kuryāt

tsa-a13-v84.plain_english: Apart from that, elsewhere one should not make excellence-thought.

tsa-a13-v85.plain_english: Everywhere, in śrāddha and the rest, the guru alone one should worship.

tsa-a13-v86.plain_english: And in all occasionals, śākinī-and-the-rest words one should not say.
tsa-a13-v86.sanskrit_cite: sarveṣu ca naimittikeṣu śākinītyādiśabdān na vadet

tsa-a13-v88.plain_english: With those of lower sight, Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, company one should not make.
tsa-a13-v88.sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādyair adhodṛṣṭibhiḥ saha saṃgatiṃ na kuryāt

tsa-a13-v89.plain_english: Abiding in this teaching, one should not see with former-birth thought.

tsa-a13-v90.plain_english: When the guru's circle has come home, as able one should do worship.

tsa-a13-v91.plain_english: A lower-path abider, a Vaiṣṇava and the rest, having even made him guru, from his teaching-clan one should abandon.
tsa-a13-v91.sanskrit_cite: adhomārgasthitaṃ kaṃcit vaiṣṇavādyaṃ tacchāstrakulāt gurūkṛtyāpi tyajet

tsa-a13-v92.plain_english: Even then one should not see with excellence-thought.

tsa-a13-v93.plain_english: With mark-bearers no conduct-meeting one should make; them only as able one should worship.
tsa-a13-v93.sanskrit_cite: liṅgibhiḥ saha samācāramelanaṃ na kuryāt tān kevalaṃ yathāśakti pūjayet

tsa-a13-v95.plain_english: In the wheel, standing, of last-and-first division, birth-made, one should not fancy.
tsa-a13-v95.sanskrit_cite: cakre sthitaś caramāgryādivibhāgaṃ janmakṛtaṃ na saṃkalpayet

tsa-a13-v96.plain_english: Apart from the body, no other abode-ford and the rest with high regard one should see.
tsa-a13-v96.sanskrit_cite: śarīrāt ṛte na anyat āyatanatīrthādikaṃ bahumānena paśyet

tsa-a13-v97.plain_english: Constantly one should remember the mantra-heart — thus the disciple, having heard, having bowed, having accepted, the guru with wealth-wife-body-up-to gift pleasing, and the before-initiated and poor-lordless and the rest sating.
tsa-a13-v97.sanskrit_cite: mantrahṛdayam anavarataṃ smaret ity evaṃ śiṣyaḥ śrutvā praṇamya abhyupagamya guruṃ dhanadāraśarīraparyantayā dakṣiṇayā paritoṣya pūrvadīkṣitāṃś ca dīnānāthādikān tarpayet

tsa-a13-v98.plain_english: And with the future rule, the image-wheel one should sate.

tsa-a13-v100.plain_english: In mantra-practice, daily worship, hearing, study, one is entitled; but in the occasional, everywhere the guru alone one should request.
tsa-a13-v100.sanskrit_cite: mantrābhyāse nityapūjāyāṃ śravaṇe 'dhyayane adhikārī naimittike tu sarvatra gurum eva abhyarthayet

sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 13 completes the samayin arc (a12 snāna assumed before it; a14–a16 putraka/special dīkṣās follow): the beginner's binding path before power-descent rites. Kin: a12 (bathing), a20 (nitya/naimittika worship), a22 (Kaula close). Witnesses: OccultGuide full ahnika, vishvasa English rendering — parallels, not sources.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) place doctrine — gladness the only mark, meditated-identity the cause, seats as aids, entered powers and solitude-concentration; (2) nyāsa — general placing hands-then-body, two mantras with Śakti-first and release/enjoyment order, Mālinī unfolded (form, name, power over broken/stained), vessel nyāsa showing every-factor-Lord with becoming-Lord by seeing; (3) entry — retinue, door, unguarded-outside relocation, weapon-flower clearing, kindled-gaze survey, north-facing burning, direction principle; (4) directions — middle light, quarters by light-relations, Bhairava faces, no-separate-principle, shadow-overstepping centrality, sun-as-knowledge-power, triad-unification per gurus; (5) throne — I-feeling burning, waveless abode, first-digit form, wheel-placing with powers chief, seat-ness reasons, six states, sixfold seal, fullness as Bhairavī-being with objection answered, Lord-made seeing; (6) trident-lotus — body-breath-mind placing, root-to-Sadāśiva ascent, inner worship definitions, spark-retinue, khecarī verses, inner-sufficiency with outer-need; (7) adhivāsa — preparation list, daily rite, three adhivāsa meanings, in-house swelling, assembly, ground-taking, jar-making, second vessel, guardians, handing, guru's jar, procession, attentiveness, 'bho' oneness, placing, both worshipped, center worship; (8) fire and oblation — fire-pit with heart-fire unity, mantra-sating, refining rites, full-oblation posture, caru sharing, tooth-stick, weapon oblation; (9) disciple — blindfold flower-cast, unveiled one-making with visible nearness, bond-burning right hand, gentle left with bowing, outer offering with sipping, oneness-stay, dream silence, weapon-expiation; (10) entry — breath-course six-place touching, eight refinements each, rest, descend, 48 + Rudra-part = samayin, mantra bestowal; (11) samaya code — devotion/aversion/reverence, name-silence, no play, no mixing, no birth-thought, hospitality, apostate-abandoning, sect-distance, doubt-abandoning, wheel-equality, body-supreme, mantra-heart; (12) dakṣiṇā and close — wealth-to-body giving, priors/poor sating, image-wheel, entitlement with guru-needed occasionals, final seal.
